title: The Ecology of AI Risk
summary_en: Building on the idea of studying AI using ecological and evolutionary perspectives, we propose a novel approach for assessing risk from AI using indicators derived from theoretical ecology models.

title: Compounding Asymmetries in Nucleic Acid Synthesis Screening: Policy Pathways for Strengthening Global Biosecurity Governance
summary_en: This perspective argues that narrowing global screening asymmetries requires reframing adoption as a spectrum rather than an all-or-nothing compliance threshold.
title_cn: Compounding Asymmetries in Nucleic Acid Synthesis Screening: Policy Pathways for Strengthening Global Biosecurity Governance

title: Aspire to STEM: Evaluation Report
summary_en: Evaluated the Aspire to STEM programme, which funded bespoke CPD and STEM enrichment in disadvantaged English secondary schools, finding it slightly increased pupil progression to STEM A levels but had no effect on science teacher retention.
